newsitem.title: USA: Chevron Corp Q3 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Chevron Corp Q3 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

Note - Latest third quarter results included a $5 million gain fom special items, while the 1995 quarter included special charges of $222 million. 1996 nine-month results included a gain of $177 million from special items, mostly the company's share of its Caltex affiliate's second quarter gain from the sale of refinery interests in Japan. 1995 nine-month results were reduced $163 million by special charges, mostly related to the company's disposal of its real estate business.

Included in 1996 third quarter net income were foreign exchange gains of $6 million compared with foreign exchange losses of $26 million in 1995. For the first nine months, foreign exchange losses were $14 million in 1996 and $20 million in 1995.
